records.reachability: Build tooling is installed in an isolated PEP 517 environment, not the API/worker interpreter. The vulnerable functions consume package index URLs, archive paths or source-manifest exclusions; malicious build inputs can affect artifact integrity.
records.exposure: Trusted local and private hosted builds only; no merchant data or runtime HTTP entry point. Read-only checkout credentials do not eliminate build integrity risk.
records.resolution: vulnerable exact build pin replaced; patched pin mirrored into the hash-locked strict dependency audit; no waiver
records.rationale: Fixed versions install and build successfully. The patched requirements audit reports no advisories for these tools. Runtime dependency declarations are unchanged and the rebuilt API interpreter has neither tool installed. Every future workspace build pin must enter the audit, which rejects every advisory.
